name: diff-view
title: Diff View
description: What changed between two texts — changed lines, then the words inside them, removed struck through and added tinted — with the sanctioned diff engine in its own lazily loaded chunk; line-only above 200 KB.

meta.whenToUse: Comparing two versions of a page's Markdown in a version history.
meta.whenNotToUse: Code review with side-by-side hunks, or live change tracking while editing.
